title: Real Estate Law Clerk
description:
About the Company
Forge Recruitment is currently conducting a search for a Real Estate Law Clerk to join a top tier mid-size Law Firm in downtown Toronto. This firm embodies work-life balance and has an excellent reputation

About the Role
  • Lender-side financings including reviewing the commitment letter, contacting the borrower's counsel for the requested information, ordering preliminary title and off title searches, preparing the security documents, coordinating with borrower's counsel on the execution of documents, setting the closing date, ordering closing searches, and completing closing registration and reporting to client.
  • Borrower-side financings including reviewing the commitment letter, contacting the borrower for requested information and relaying said information to lender's counsel in a timely manner, ordering preliminary title and off title searches, preparing any ancillary documents, compiling, organizing, and blacklining security documents, coordinating with borrower on the execution of documents, docusigning closing documents, ordering necessary closing searches, and reporting to client.
  • Conduct mortgage discharge/partial discharge subdivision.
  • Conduct progress advances.
  • Handling a variety of purchases and sales files from inception to completion.
  • Prepare and review deeds, affidavits and agreements of purchase and sale.
  • Organize and coordinate files and closings.
  • Conduct title search and registrations of documentation in Teraview and
  • Conveyancer.
  • Draft transaction documents, send requisition letters and conduct title searches for residential and commercial purchases and sales
  • Experience with Land Titles Applications (LTA) and historical title searching is an asset.
  • Perform ancillary duties, including administrative tasks, as requested from time to time.

What You Bring
  • 2-3 years of experience as real estate law clerk
  • Law Clerk or equivalent degree/diploma preferred
  • Proficiency in MSOffice, Teraview and Conveyancer.
  • Ability to work independently with strong follow up skills.
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication (oral and written) skills
  • Ability to multi-task.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills and time management skills.
  • Self-starter, motivated and hardworking.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrated commitment to professionalism, integrity, and client service.

Next Steps
If you are interested in learning more about this opportunity, please apply, in confidence. Thank you for your interest in the position and in Forge Recruitment.
